agreements: On a complete equally weighted binary tool-by-mode grid, the crossed formula y(t,j)=b(t) XOR j with exactly two orientations of each value per stratum caps the five named deterministic shortcut families at balanced accuracy 0.50, and row-wise complementation preserves those caps.

The proposed scout is a supervised writer-capacity assay over seen keys; it is not an assay of parenting, child authorship, lived experience, continual learning, retention, unseen-key generalization, or an internal routing mechanism.
Both engineered roots must remain separately qualified with no pooling, root replacement, semantic retry, rank or dose change, post-result retuning, or rescue after results are opened.

Training, primary held evaluation, explicit-map oracle evaluation, sealed reduction, and independent review need distinct serialized visibility contracts; the explicit-map oracle is necessarily map-visible while primary requests remain map-blind.

Current authority, if later ratified, is limited to the three named implementation files, deterministic CPU tests, and V8-local review artifacts; model, tokenizer, training, adapter, GPU, lineage, parenting, C11, claim, release, and submission actions remain separately forbidden.

The human ruling requires bounded experiment-local hygiene for this scout and defers the reusable custody, process-isolation, adversarial-filesystem, and security guard to the final paper-grade C11 run.

A real pinned-tokenizer geometry check is necessary before fitting but cannot be executed within the current tokenizer-forbidden scope; current CPU tests may exercise only tokenizer-free invariants and a fake-tokenizer contract.
The independent implementation reviewer and separate scientific advocate must inspect identical bound evidence, and an independent rejection controls any later execution request.

disagreements.issue: Whether the present shortcut proof establishes that every successful policy must use opaque tool identity jointly with visible mode.

positions.position: The XOR mapping and five enumerated shortcut families make joint opaque-tool and mode use necessary.

The proof applies only to the named factor-restricted families on an equally weighted grid and does not exclude surface-only, surface-by-mode, identifier-morphology, or other model-visible substitutes or establish an internal mechanism.

resolution.rationale: The scientific limitation is correct, but the proposal does not freeze the complete model-visible nuisance projection or its exact multiplicities on the serialized training and held multisets. The intended functional-identifiability statement therefore cannot yet be implemented or ratified exactly.
resolution.selected_position: Limit necessity to the five explicitly tested shortcut classes and to any additional declared model-visible categorical covariates whose exact schedules are proven target-balanced; make no internal-routing inference.
resolution.required_change: Rework the normative design to enumerate every model-visible non-key field, freeze exact training and held template, rendering, ordering, and seed schedules with equal item weights across slot orientation and mode, define how identifier morphology is treated, and replace all unqualified joint-route wording with a behavioral statement limited to the tested families.

disagreements.issue: Whether the strongest pass sentence may imply successful directional binding on every one of the sixteen keys.

positions.position: The adapter carried conditional behavior over an interaction surface spanning sixteen seen keys.
The surface contains sixteen evaluated keys, but the directional gate permits four keys to miss and aggregate generated scores can hide key-level failures.

resolution.rationale: The declared thresholds do not support an all-keys directional reading. Per-key NLL improvement is not a substitute until its exact action-specific token span and contrast are frozen.
resolution.selected_position: Any later permitted pass wording must say that all sixteen keys were evaluated, that the per-key NLL gate held as exactly defined, and that directional evidence met aggregate and per-stratum thresholds on at least 12/16 and 6/8 keys respectively; it must not say or imply that every key bound.
resolution.required_change: Replace the strongest permitted pass sentence and every equivalent summary with the selected aggregate/per-stratum wording before human implementation ratification.

disagreements.issue: Whether the 0.50 own-map versus opposite-map separation threshold is independent specificity evidence.

positions.position: The separation threshold is one of the writer pass gates.

Under complementary scoring of the same outputs with invalids wrong for both maps, own-map balanced accuracy at least 0.80 already implies separation at least 0.60, so the 0.50 condition is redundant.

resolution.rationale: The algebra is correct under the natural same-output complementary definition. The threshold may still detect scoring or data corruption but cannot be counted as independent scientific support.
resolution.selected_position: Retain the 0.50 separation only as a consistency canary if the reworked metric uses same-output complementary scoring; retain mirrored gain over OFF only after its separate exact formula is fixed. If another estimand is intended, it must be defined and justified anew.
resolution.required_change: State the diagnostic status in the decision rule and report, and bind the exact own-map, opposite-map, invalid-output, and OFF-gain equations in golden reducer tests.

disagreements.issue: How orientation bits are made precommitted and independent of opaque identifier bytes.

positions.position: A precommitted balanced orientation exists, but no slot-level procedure or provenance is specified.

Orientations must attach to abstract slots using an identifier-free committed construction, with slot-to-identifier assignment bound separately and identifier mutation unable to change slot orientation.

resolution.rationale: The systems data-dependency requirement is accepted, but neither an exact literal slot table nor an exact domain-separated seed algorithm appears in the normative bytes. Balance alone cannot establish independence or precommitment, and choosing between materially different constructions cannot be left to implementation.
resolution.selected_position: Use one exact human-ratified abstract-slot orientation construction that consumes no identifier bytes, bind slot-to-identifier assignment separately, and preserve two zeros and two ones in each stratum. A literal table is sufficient and simpler than a random derivation; random derivation is not required.
resolution.required_change: Rework the normative design to provide the exact slot names and orientation bits, or a complete domain-separated seed-to-balanced-table algorithm, plus separately bound identifier assignment, root/stratum namespace definitions, provenance records, and identifier-mutation behavior.

disagreements.issue: Whether orientation mapping may be forbidden for the entire held evaluator while an explicit-map OFF oracle is required.

positions.position: orientation_mapping is forbidden at held_evaluator, yet held evaluation includes an explicit-map OFF oracle.
Primary map-blind evaluation and explicit-map oracle evaluation must be distinct typed stages and request/cache identities, with rendered mapping visible only to the oracle.

resolution.rationale: An oracle that can answer from an explicit map necessarily receives rendered map information. The existing visibility cell is false and cannot be implemented literally.
resolution.selected_position: Split held evaluation into a map-blind primary generation/likelihood stage and a typed explicit-map OFF-oracle stage. Only the oracle request sees rendered mapping; oracle prompts, outputs, and cache records are forbidden from fitting and primary evaluation.
resolution.required_change: Replace the visibility matrix with the split stages, define exact serialized allowlists and disjoint request/cache operation kinds, and add anti-flow fixtures before ratification.

disagreements.issue: Whether matched target geometry can be established without tokenizer execution in the current CPU-only scope.

positions.position: W+ and W- have matched target lengths and training geometry.
UTF-8 equality does not establish pinned-tokenizer token count, loss-mask, EOS, boundary, or truncation equality; the real tokenizer check needs later authority.

resolution.rationale: Tokenizer-dependent geometry cannot truthfully be certified by the current tokenizer-forbidden scope. Deferring the real check without making it an aborting pre-fit gate would leave a confound.
resolution.selected_position: Current CPU work may certify exact byte/string geometry and fake-tokenizer contract behavior only. A separately authorized, manifest-bound pinned-tokenizer preflight must run before model load or fitting and abort on any target/candidate token, loss-mask, EOS, boundary, maximum-length, or truncation mismatch.
resolution.required_change: Split the geometry requirement and tests into the current tokenizer-free portion and a later execution-manifest preflight; do not describe CPU evidence as tokenizer-level evidence.

disagreements.issue: How much path, cache, hash, retry, stage, and seal hardening belongs in the simple V8 scout.

positions.position: Use a compact set of fail-if-exists, symlink, hash, cache, adapter, receipt, and replay checks for this isolated scout.

Adopt a broad catalogue including generalized ancestor/protected-tree analysis, special-file handling, collision fixtures, interruption injection before every receipt, universal canonicalization, and exhaustive retry-state machinery.

resolution.rationale: Exact local semantics are needed for promises already made by V8, but the wholesale systems catalogue conflicts with the human ruling to keep this scout simple. The proposal does not yet give a byte-exact bounded contract from which T03 can be implemented without judgment.
resolution.selected_position: Require only experiment-local controls: one explicitly configured nonexisting run root outside the fixed protected roots; symlink refusal for its existing path components; exclusive creation and contained writes; hashes and canonical encodings only for the named V8 artifact types; complete request identity with payload revalidation; one preserved pre-output infrastructure retry for identical bytes; adapter identity/hash verification; fail-if-exists stage receipts; final sealing; and in-memory reducer replay. Explicitly defer OS/process isolation, adversarial filesystem custody, generalized ancestor or special-file threat handling, hash-collision semantics, interruption injection at every write, universal serialization machinery, and a reusable guard substrate to C11.
resolution.required_change: Rework the simple-hygiene section into exact experiment-local path, serialization, request terminal-state, retry, adapter, receipt, and replay rules for the selected bounded controls, and list every rejected broader hardening item as deferred C11 work. Do not silently import the systems catalogue.

disagreements.issue: Whether pass wording should distinguish an evaluated sixteen-key surface from individual success at all keys.

positions.position: The strongest sentence describes carriage over sixteen seen keys without an explicit aggregate-only qualifier.
The sentence must identify aggregate and per-stratum thresholds and state that not every key is required to meet the directional margin.

resolution.rationale: This is the same substantive claim-boundary issue as SCI-D02, and both interpretations agree on the correction.
resolution.selected_position: Adopt the aggregate/per-stratum qualifier and the explicit all-keys disclaimer from SCI-D02.
resolution.required_change: Apply the corrected wording consistently to the normative claim boundary, reducer report schema, and any later review or execution request.

disagreements.issue: Whether the numerical decision gates are sufficiently specified to produce unique report bytes.

positions.position: Named measurements and scalar thresholds are sufficient to define the reducer.
Equations, units, token spans, item weights, denominators, aggregation order, invalid and missing record rules, multi-token scoring, and equality semantics are implementation-affecting and absent.

resolution.rationale: These choices can change pass/fail outcomes. An adjudicator cannot infer them from scalar thresholds or choose them silently during implementation.
resolution.selected_position: Every metric must be a total byte-bound function over a frozen record multiset, with exact units, score spans, weights, denominators, invalid/missing behavior, aggregation order, and inclusive threshold comparisons specified before reducer implementation.
resolution.required_change: Rework the normative design with equations and golden examples for generated accuracy and balanced accuracy, validity, sequence log-odds and directional margin, held-target NLL and its exact token span including prefix/EOS policy, even-sample medians, adapter mean-gain difference, own/opposite separation, OFF gain, oracle scoring, every interface predicate, and spill total variation and legal-ACT emission changes. Define multi-token action scoring, prompt/seed aggregation, fixed denominators, missing likelihood handling, and every equality boundary.

disagreements.issue: Whether the stated label order defines a total, mutually exclusive reducer classification.

positions.position: The six labels are evaluated in the named order where applicable.
Applicability, co-failure precedence, threshold equality, root combination, and non-reportable integrity aborts are not defined, so multiple implementations can assign different labels.

resolution.rationale: The phrase 'where applicable' is not an executable partition. The missing predicates directly affect required reducer fixtures and scientific outcome bytes.
resolution.selected_position: Integrity, provenance, or missing-required-record failures must abort as non-reportable rather than receive a scientific label; for otherwise complete evidence, the design must define one total mutually exclusive predicate and exact precedence for every scientific label and both-root combination.
resolution.required_change: Rework the normative design to define exact predicates for OPTIMIZATION_INCONCLUSIVE, ASSAY_INVALID, INTERFACE_INVALID, BINDING_WITH_SPILL, MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS, and GATEWAY_NEGATIVE; specify no-learning, oracle, primary validity, interface, spill, binding, missing-root, and cross-root co-failures; identify non-reportable aborts; and cover every label, equality boundary, and required pairwise precedence in golden fixtures.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The five-family proof does not cover serialized surface or surface-by-mode substitutes, and identifier morphology cannot be excluded by calling identifiers opaque. The claim must be limited and the nuisance schedule must be exact.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add the exact observable-surface contract and MWG8_T05, then qualify every joint-key necessity statement to the explicitly enumerated and tested shortcut families.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Two-of-each balance proves geometry but not identifier-independent causal construction. An exact slot-level rule and auditable separate identifier assignment are required.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Supply exact identifier-free orientation provenance and MWG8_T06 before another implementation-ratification request.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current visibility matrix contradicts the explicit-map oracle. Typed primary and oracle stages with anti-flow rules are necessary and remain simple serialized-interface hygiene, not C11 process custody.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Revise the visibility matrix and add MWG8_T07 with disjoint typed requests and cache identities.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The omitted equations and aggregation rules can move the same raw records across fixed thresholds. This is a blocking design omission, not an implementation detail.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze all metric formulas and golden records described in MWG8_T09 before implementation ratification.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The six labels lack a total predicate partition and deterministic co-failure precedence. Required fixtures cannot be written uniquely from the present prose.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define non-reportable aborts, all six exact label predicates, both-root combination, and precedence, then add MWG8_T10.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Byte/string geometry is all the current scope can establish. Real tokenizer geometry is required later but remains expressly outside present authority.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Split MWG8_T08 into CPU fake-tokenizer contract tests and a separately authorized real pinned-tokenizer pre-fit abort gate.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The critique is correct that local integrity terms need exact semantics, but unnecessary C11-like hardening is rejected. V8 must not add generalized custody, adversarial filesystem or collision machinery, universal canonicalization, exhaustive interruption injection, process isolation, or a reusable guard substrate.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify only the bounded experiment-local controls selected in MWG8_SYS_D04 and explicitly defer the rejected hardening catalogue to final paper-grade C11.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The thresholds support aggregate and per-stratum directional evidence on an evaluated sixteen-key surface, not individual directional success on all sixteen keys or an internal routing mechanism.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use the corrected pass wording in the scope, report schema, reviews, and any later request.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The redundancy result is accepted conditional on same-output complementary scoring and invalids failing both scores. Because the proposal has not fixed that equation, the conclusion must remain conditional until MWG8_T09 binds it.
concern_dispositions.required_change: If natural complementary scoring is retained, label separation a consistency canary rather than independent evidence; otherwise define and justify the alternative estimand exactly.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The scientific interpretation correctly rejects an unqualified joint-route statement; exact nuisance crossing remains missing.
The all-sixteen-key implication exceeds the declared directional and aggregate thresholds.
The redundancy proof is correct under the natural complementary scoring definition and is adopted conditionally on that exact metric choice.
Identifier-independent slot provenance is required, but random derivation is not uniquely necessary; a literal bound slot table is also sufficient.
The stage-level visibility contradiction is real and must be corrected with a typed oracle exception and isolation tests.
Tokenizer-level geometry cannot be certified in a scope that forbids tokenizer execution; a later real preflight is mandatory.
Exact semantics for promised local controls are accepted, while generalized C11-like hardening is explicitly rejected for V8 and deferred.
Aggregate/per-stratum wording is necessary to prevent an unsupported all-key interpretation.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain core counts, complement, mutation, and five-family enumeration, but run them on exact materialized training and held multisets with integer confusion counts, exact equal weights, explicit root/surface/seed disjointness definitions, and separate orientation provenance. Adopt the critique's missing MWG8_T05_OBSERVABLE_SURFACE and MWG8_T06_ORIENTATION_PROVENANCE coverage here. Split MWG8_T08_TOKENIZER_PREFLIGHT into current MWG8_T08A_CPU_FAKE_TOKENIZER contract fixtures and a future separately authorized MWG8_T08B_REAL_TOKENIZER_PREFLIGHT abort gate; do not claim tokenizer-level geometry from current CPU evidence.

Inspect byte-exact serialized stage inputs through allowlisted projections, distinguish legitimate supervised targets from forbidden map metadata, and split map-blind primary evaluation from the explicit-map oracle. Adopt the critique's missing MWG8_T07_ORACLE_ISOLATION coverage here. Preserve strict parsing and fixed-denominator invalids.

Retain only the exact experiment-local path, hash, cache, adapter, receipt, and replay fixtures promised by the reworked simple-hygiene contract. Adopt the critique's missing MWG8_T09_METRIC_GOLDENS and MWG8_T10_LABEL_PARTITION coverage after the normative equations and predicates are fixed. Reject the broad C11-like hardening catalogue for V8.

Retain the two distinct review roles and independent veto, while binding reviewer role, exact source/test/manifest/dry-run hashes, and identical evidence. No generalized custody machinery is required.
